top_signals.title: Ellison's Skydance Announced Merger Details
top_signals.summary: Paramount Skydance Corp. outlined the executive leadership team that will helm the new company resulting from its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.  David Ellison will continue to serve as chief executive officer and chairman, overseeing the company’s long-term strategy and creative vision, while co-CEO Ynon Kreiz will focus on day-to-day management. Bloomberg New Media Reporter Hannah Miller breaks down the latest news on the closely-watched merger. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Babylist CEO on New NYC Showroom, Growth Targets
top_signals.summary: Babylist CEO Jennifer Hyman discusses the company’s new 20,000-square-foot showroom in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood, which opened at the end of September and is its largest retail location yet. Hyman says the space is designed to help expecting and new parents research major purchases with expert guidance: visitors can learn about products, try baby carriers and get help installing car seats. She speaks with Scarlet Fu on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Mark Walter Charity’s CLO Tie-Up Maps Intricacies of His Empire
top_signals.summary: Even at the time, it was considered an unconventional alliance: Mark Walter committing $160 million through his education-focused nonprofit to help a Chicago credit investment firm comply with Dodd-Frank regulations in return for funding.
